title: Huge News for Uber Stock Investors as it Makes Multibillion Dollar Acquisition
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc breaks down Uber's $2.3B all-cash acquisition of ezCater (workplace catering platform, $2.5B TTM gross bookings, high-teens growth, $400+ avg orders): likely a slight overpay but strategically sound as defense against driverless-car risk; using cash signals management views the shares as undervalued. Reaffirms UBER as one of the best stocks to buy at $69 with FV $115.

calls.thesis: ezCater $2.3B all-cash deal may be a slight overpay (~0.9x gross bookings vs Uber's own ~0.6x), but strategically sound as robotaxi defense; using cash not equity signals management views shares as undervalued; FV $115, still one of the best stocks to buy.
calls.base_case: Acquisition near-neutral to slightly positive; FV $115 vs ~$69 price.
calls.bull_case: FV $115 implies ~66% upside if delivery scale and AV defense re-rate it.
calls.bear_case: If overpay thesis is right, paid above its own multiple for slower-growing bookings.
